template_data.sub: Most small businesses come to the table with nothing specific to offer — and wonder why primes don't call back.

Right: illustrated prime contractor at desk reviewing a shortlist, green checkmarks beside 3 specific labels (2-3 words each: 'NAICS GAP', 'CERT NEEDED', 'REGION COVERAGE'). Amber callout box center: 'NO SPEC = NO DEAL'. Footer text: 'Josh Ladick · GSA Focus'.
